newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Monday, 16 June.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Monday, 16 June.

text.p: Following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.

* Seven national referendums held on Sunday on issues ranging from hunting to privatisation failed to secure the turnout required to be valid. Less than 30 percent of Italy's 49 million eligible voters cast ballots -- more than 50 percent were needed in order for the process to be valid (all).

* The Italian Treasury named a new chairman and board for indebted state industrial holding IRI to oversee privatisation of sellable assets and wind up the ailing giant's operations. A Treasury statement said the new appointments, which would see outgoing chairman Michele Tedeschi replaced by Gian Maria Gros-Pietro, would be put to an IRI shareholders' meeting on Monday (all).

* In an interview, IRI's newly appointed president Gian Maria Gros-Pietro said the privatisation of the state industrial holding was possible and the group would have to look for foreign economic partners (La Stampa).
Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
